final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no genuinely new admissible evidence. The response is a narrower reinterpretation of the same summarized evidence: one late quality artifact, an informal and undocumented quality process, a storage-control inconsistency, and a procurement recommendation for follow-up if storage controls remained unresolved. That reframing improves coherence and avoids the overstated claim of a proven control failure, but it does not resolve the core audit gap: whether admissible evidence alone, at the time of decision, was sufficient to satisfy the policy threshold of material unresolved risk for rejection rather than follow-up or escalation. On this record, the rejection remains plausible but not adequately substantiated as compliant.
